global_rules.full_coverage_required: All 19 categories must be checked. Do not omit, merge, rename, skip, or reorder categories.
global_rules.input_material_contract: Evidence is organized by all available Ocean segments, not a reduced sample. Use segment_frame for images from ocean_segment_frame_urls, segment_asr for text from ocean_segment_ASR, comment_interaction for the extracted comment section, and pearl_product_title/pearl_product_image for bound products.
global_rules.evidence_required_for_hit: Every hit must have concrete evidence from allowed materials and must identify the source segment/material.
global_rules.no_extra_policy: Only the listed category definitions and thresholds may be used. Do not invent new policy categories.
global_rules.foreign_language_handling: Understand segment ASR and text visible in segment frames in the original language. Final evidence explanation must be Chinese; direct quotes may remain in original language.
global_rules.product_image_permission: Pearl product images may only be used by categories listed in product_image_allowed_category_ids.
global_rules.case_calibration_source: Calibrated with the normalized 2026-10-15 reviewed baseline (13 reviewed, user override). Use these reviewed boundaries without inferring new metrics.

exclusive_priority_rules.rule_zh: 若直播核心内容与商品无关且没有持续商品推广，应判定【商品无关低质问题】（类别3），而非【无实物商品展示低质问题】（类别5）。
exclusive_priority_rules.rule_en: If the unrelated live core has no sustained promotion, classify as category 3, not category 5.

exclusive_priority_rules.rule_zh: 若直播内容无明确、持续的商品推广、讲解、演示行为，核心内容与绑定商品无任何关联，或长时间不挂品/不讲品/只直播比赛、聊天、个人生活，一律优先判定为【商品无关低质问题】，不得改判为【商品描述不详细低质问题】。
exclusive_priority_rules.rule_en: If there is no clear sustained product promotion, explanation, or demonstration intent, including long periods with no pinned product, no product talk, sports/game/life-chat as the core content, classify as category 3 and do not classify as category 6.

exclusive_priority_rules.rule_zh: 色情暴露、性暗示类内容归为【色情低俗低质问题】，不得同时归为【隐私敏感商品低质问题】。
exclusive_priority_rules.rule_en: Sexual exposure or sexualized implication belongs to category 1, not category 19.

exclusive_priority_rules.rule_zh: 若问题本质是直播展示商品与挂车商品/商品图在实体、类目、用途上明显不一致，优先按【违法违规商品低质问题】中的货不对板/IPP 边界判断，不得因为商品图语言、异域服饰、OCR 文本或标题语言而判为【非母语违规低质问题】。
exclusive_priority_rules.rule_en: When the core issue is a clear entity/category/use-case mismatch between the live displayed item and bound Pearl product, route it to category 15 product-mismatch/IPP boundary, not category 8 language violation.

exclusive_priority_rules.rule_zh: 若主播围绕商品说话但直播画面长期没有真实实物视频展示，只出现贴图、截图、商品卡、静态照片、产品角标或不可识别局部，优先判定【无实物商品展示低质问题】，不得仅因讲解信息少而判定【商品描述不详细低质问题】。
exclusive_priority_rules.rule_en: If product talk exists but most live frames lack real physical video display of the bound product and show only stickers, screenshots, product cards, static photos, overlays, or unrecognizable partials, classify category 5 before category 6.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any segment frame or segment ASR evidence hits the listed visual or speech scenario.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播画面或语音中出现明确列出的性暗示、性挑逗、低俗暴露类内容。
categories.judge_focus_en: Only flag listed sexualized exposure or sexualized behavior with explicit sexual framing. Ordinary try-on, gym activity, swimwear, and shapewear without explicit sexual framing are clean.
exemptions: Non-deliberate cleavage exposure is not enough.
Normal bikini in beach context is generally public-appropriate.
Ordinary try-on, gym activity, swimwear, or shapewear without explicit sexual framing is exempt.

categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only when the dominant content creates strong discomfort through qualifying disgusting or horror material. Cleaning and novelty/product art, calendar, or packaging contexts are hard-exempt.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 仅当直播主体内容存在达到强烈不适程度的恶心恐怖材料时命中；清洁场景及新奇商品艺术、日历或包装展示为硬豁免。
categories.judge_focus_en: Require dominant strong discomfort, not an isolated unpleasant detail. Cleaning, cleaning-product use, novelty/product art, calendar imagery, and packaging are hard-exempt.
exemptions: Any active cleaning of the disgusting/horror environment is hard-exempt.
Novelty/product art, calendar imagery, and product packaging are hard-exempt.

categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only when a sustained unrelated core dominates across available segments and there is no sustained promotion of bound products. A short opening or off-topic passage followed by a later substantive product demonstration is clean.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播核心内容与直播间绑定商品的电商推广无任何关联，或长时间不挂品、不讲品，只直播比赛/活动/聊天/个人生活等非商品内容。
categories.judge_focus_en: Use bound product image category/function/use-case as reference. Require a sustained unrelated core with no sustained promotion. Category 3 has priority over categories 5 and 6 for unrelated dominance. If the room later provides substantive product demonstration, a short opening or off-topic passage is clean. If live item and bound product are mismatched, check category 15 product-mismatch/IPP.
exemptions: Auction, lottery, card-opening, or fast-selling rooms are not product-unrelated when the host is clearly selling or opening the bound product type.
A short opening or off-topic chat is exempt when later substantive product demonstration establishes sustained promotion.

categories.trigger_threshold: Hit when most available segment ASR evidence, supported by comment_interaction when available, shows both no product promotion and no host-audience interaction. Do not use a fixed ratio threshold from the old workflow.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播内容既无商品推广行为，也无主播与观众的互动行为。
categories.judge_focus_en: Evaluate all available segments. A single quiet or unrelated segment is not enough; require a sustained lack of both promotion and interaction.

categories.category_name: 无实物商品展示低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Hit when most available segment frame groups show no real physical video display of the bound product: only sticker/cutout/photo/screenshot/static image, product card, small product thumbnail/overlay, no product, or only unrecognizable partial product. A real package, wearing, installation, operation, or application/use counts as physical display.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 主播虽可能围绕商品讲解，但直播画面长期没有以真实视频画面展示绑定实物商品，只出现贴图/截图/商品卡/静态照片/角标或不可识别局部。
categories.judge_focus_en: Main judgment is live visual physical display, not whether the host verbally mentions the product. A real package, wearing, installation, operation, and application/use count as physical display. Product cards, Pearl photos, overlays, and screenshots do not. Unrelated dominance routes to category 3; live-versus-bound mismatch routes to category 15.
exemptions: A product is visible as a real physical object in most relevant live frames, even if the explanation is brief.
A real package, wearing, installation, operation, or application/use is a physical display.
Temporary camera movement or a few frames without product are not enough.

categories.category_name: 商品描述不详细低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only when clear product promotion exists and most relevant promotion remains extremely low-information after considering all available segments. An identifiable product or package plus its core purpose, or any core buying fact, blocks category 6. Do not require deep ingredient detail or mechanism explanation.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 主播有明确商品推广、讲解、演示意图和持续行为，但大多数相关时段几乎没有提供有效购买信息，或讲解长期跑题到无法帮助理解商品。
categories.judge_focus_en: This category is conservative. An identifiable product or package plus its core purpose blocks category 6, as does any core buying fact such as category, function, use, size, color, price, discount, brand, quantity, condition, ingredients, material, scent/flavor, compatibility, or delivery/return terms. No deep ingredient analysis or mechanism explanation is required. Auction identifiers and bid rules can be valid commerce facts. Use category 3 for no promotion, category 5 for no physical display, and category 15 for product mismatch.
exemptions: An identifiable product or package plus its core purpose blocks category 6.
Clear product display plus any core function/category/use/size/price/brand/condition/quantity/bundle information is enough to avoid this category, even if the explanation is brief.
Auction or bidding mechanics are exempt when the host shows products and provides basic identifying or purchasing information.
Merely wearing or showing product with no promotion/explanation is exempt.
Unrelated live content with no promotion intent belongs to category 3, not category 6.
Missing advanced specs, deep ingredient analysis, mechanism explanation, or deep material explanation is not a hit by itself.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any segment frame group shows an occlusion/interruption layer covering at least 80% of the live screen and seriously blocking viewing.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播画面中出现覆盖大面积区域的遮挡层，严重影响观众观看。
categories.judge_focus_en: Both 80%+ coverage and serious viewing interference are required.

categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only when segment ASR or visible text in segment frames uses a language that is not acceptable for the target market, Chinese/CJK in product promotion, Chinglish, incomprehensible English, or severely broken English, and this prevents normal product understanding across the live. Product mismatch, ethnic clothing style, non-English product titles, or OCR noise alone is not a language hit.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播语音或画面推广文字使用非目标市场可接受语言、中文/中日韩文字，或英语严重不可理解，导致无法正常理解商品。
categories.judge_focus_en: Judge language itself from segment ASR and visible frame text only. Do not use Pearl product images as evidence. Romanian or another non-target language can hit only if it is used in ASR or promotional on-screen text for product selling and blocks normal product understanding. If the real issue is live product vs bound product mismatch, use category 15 instead. If evidence is only OCR noise, product brand/title text, fashion design text, usernames, or non-English labels on product images, return no_hit.
exemptions: Coworker daily Chinese conversation unrelated to product promotion.
Minor accent that is easy to understand.
Normal English/local EU-language mixing, including German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, or other EU language words mixed with English.
German "Englisch" as a local-language word.
Isolated frame-text recognition noise, stylized labels, usernames, product names, or minor spelling mistakes unless overall promotion text becomes incomprehensible.
Product mismatch or item/category difference is not a language violation.

categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only when explicit generated-content evidence is present and its use in product promotion is authenticity misleading. AI-like style alone is insufficient.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中使用有明确生成证据的 AIGC 内容进行商品推广，并对内容或展示主体的真实性造成误导。
categories.judge_focus_en: Require explicit generated-content evidence plus an authenticity misleading basis, such as a fake AI voice/interview, fake before/after, or digital human presented as authentic product evidence. AI-like style alone is insufficient.
exemptions: AI-like visual or audio style alone is insufficient without explicit generated-content evidence and authenticity misleading use.

categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only with explicit generated product or use-scene evidence plus a material mismatch in product size, style, function, use, or effect against the bound real product. AI-like style alone is insufficient.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中通过 AIGC 生成商品或使用场景，存在渲染内容、与绑定真实商品夸张不符的问题。
categories.judge_focus_en: Distinguish from category 9: require an explicit generated product or use-scene and a material mismatch against the bound real product. AI-like style alone is insufficient.
exemptions: AI-like style alone is insufficient without explicit generated product or use-scene evidence and material mismatch.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any segment frame or segment ASR evidence shows clear replay/loop/pre-recorded indicators such as replay/loop labels, playback controls, video timeline, repeated sequence, abnormal jump, black/green screen, nested screen with clear replay/loop/pre-recorded feature, or segment ASR directly mentioning replay/loop playback. Browser, desktop, card-list, or spin UI alone in card-opening or lottery-like live rooms is not enough.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播间存在预录内容循环播放的相关特征。
categories.judge_focus_en: Only clear replay indicators count. Browser, desktop, OBS, card-list, spin UI, and cursor presence are weak signals, not replay by themselves. For card opening, TCG, lottery/spin, or similar live rooms, require additional replay evidence. Host face-cam used to prove real-time opening is exempt when host appears live or ASR aligns with mouth movement.
exemptions: Cursor used to point to or demonstrate product is exempt.
Browser, desktop, or OBS-style interface when consistent with real-time opening.
Wheel or spin page when consistent with real-time opening.
Card-list page when consistent with real-time opening.
Small host face-cam when consistent with real-time opening.

categories.category_name: 功能效果虚假宣传低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only when a concrete LIVE frame or ASR claim has a materially misleading basis and meets the current prevalence/strength threshold: at least half of relevant effective live promotion or repeated strong evidence. A Pearl product image is corroborative only and cannot independently create a hit.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 仅当直播画面或 ASR 中存在具体商品功能效果主张，且该主张有实质误导依据并达到现行覆盖度/强度阈值时命中；商品物料仅可佐证，不能单独构成命中。
categories.judge_focus_en: Require a concrete LIVE frame or ASR claim, a materially misleading basis, and the current prevalence/strength threshold. Product image is corroborative only. Product image copy, routine marketing, or subjective praise alone cannot hit. Strong live claims can include immediate transformation, extreme quantified results, medical/clinical therapeutic claims, body-shaping/slimming, dramatic before-after, or instant whitening.
exemptions: Ordinary improvement, comfort, hydration, shine, fragrance, coverage, hold, waterproof, tear-proof, brightening, glow, skin-friendly, dermatologist-tested, sensitive-skin-safe, price, discount, return policy, or delivery claim is exempt unless tied to strong quantified/immediate/medical transformation in live evidence.
Product image copy, routine marketing, and subjective praise alone cannot hit without a concrete LIVE frame or ASR claim and materially misleading basis.
Single weak ASR summary wording about general improvement is not enough without repeated or strong evidence.
Routine auction or promotion urgency is not a function/effect claim.

categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 segment frame or segment ASR evidence units show life-threatening violent behavior or dangerous goods demonstration, including heavy-smoke products creating fire illusion.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中出现危及生命安全的暴力行为、危险物品展示。
categories.judge_focus_en: Normal product demonstration and safe behavior are exempt.
exemptions: Normal product demonstration, explanation, and safe behavior.

categories.category_name: 站外引流交易低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only when the same scene contains both an off-platform destination/payment/account/site/app and explicit transaction guidance, with no exemption.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中引导用户通过平台外渠道完成交易。
categories.judge_focus_en: Both an off-platform destination and transaction guidance must be present in the same scene. Vague link mention alone is not enough.
exemptions: Platform-internal order guidance.
Social account jump without purchase intent.
Bio link only with no live/comment transaction guidance.
Only one of the two core conditions present.

categories.category_name: 违法违规商品低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Independent prohibited, counterfeit/imitation/inferior, jailbreak/device-modification, qualification, and other non-IPP subtypes retain their cumulative at least 2 evidence threshold. IPP specifically requires live promoted item evidence plus bound product evidence and a core entity/category/use/quantity/spec contradiction.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中销售法律法规禁止商品、假冒仿冒伪劣商品，或直播推广商品与绑定商品/商品图在实体、类目、用途、核心数量或关键规格上存在明确矛盾，构成货不对板/IPP。
categories.judge_focus_en: For IPP/product mismatch, require live promoted item evidence, bound product evidence, and a core entity/category/use/quantity/spec contradiction. A minor variant or background difference is blocked from IPP. Preserve independent prohibited, counterfeit/imitation/inferior, jailbreak/device-modification, qualification, and other non-IPP subtypes. Do not route product mismatch to category 8 language.
exemptions: Normal legal goods, regular brand goods, and ordinary product demonstrations.
A minor variant in color, style, packaging, or quantity without a core contradiction is blocked from IPP.
A background difference without a core product contradiction is blocked from IPP.
A broad catalog where the currently shown product is plausibly one of the bound products.

categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 segment frame, segment ASR, Pearl product title, or Pearl product image evidence units show political controversy, sensitive political symbols/movements, political hate symbols, racial discrimination, or polarized political narratives.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中出现可能引发政治争议、涉及敏感政治符号、仇恨言论、种族歧视、极化政治叙事的内容。
exemptions: General non-political content unrelated to controversy or sensitive symbols.

categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 segment frame, segment ASR, Pearl product title, or Pearl product image evidence units show sensitive topics related to religion, racial discrimination, moral boundary, LGBT, or similarly high-conflict socio-cultural themes.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中出现与宗教信仰、种族歧视、道德边界、LGBT 相关的高度敏感争议内容。
categories.judge_focus_en: Only the specified sensitive topic scope counts. Do not extend to unrelated controversy.
exemptions: General non-sensitive content outside the specified topic scope.

categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 segment frame, segment ASR, or Comment Interaction evidence units show sustained negative emotional guidance such as hostile arguments with viewers, insults, resentment, jealousy, anxiety/fear induction beyond routine sales, wealth flaunting or comparison pressure, or content likely to trigger negative emotion. Routine commercial urgency alone does not hit.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中持续出现争吵、羞辱、抱怨、敌意、焦虑恐惧诱导、炫富攀比、怨恨嫉妒等明显负面情绪引导。
categories.judge_focus_en: Cumulative at least 2 evidence units remain required. Routine sales pressure, knowledge marketing, and normal risk explanation are clean without sustained hostile, shaming, fear, resentment, jealousy, or similar negative guidance. Hit only when that negative guidance is sustained beyond normal commerce or explanation.
exemptions: General neutral or positive content.
Ordinary product comparison without negative emotion triggering.
Limited stock, countdown, coupon, gift, full-reduction, final minutes, pay deadline, bid countdown, or auction urgency without hostile/anxiety language.
Ordinary card-pull disappointment.
Casual streamer banter.
Slang or hype language without sustained negative guidance.
Knowledge marketing and normal risk explanation without shaming, hostility, resentment, jealousy, or fear pressure.

categories.category_name: 隐私敏感商品低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Disabled for current Live Ocean Low Quality calibration. Always return no_hit for this category unless future policy explicitly re-enables it. Do not identify sanitary products, underwear, gender-specific care, or private-use non-pornographic products under category 19 in this workflow version.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 当前工作流版本不识别隐私敏感商品低质问题；该类别保留用于 19 类覆盖，但默认不命中。
categories.judge_focus_en: Category disabled by the 2026-10-15 v3 reviewed baseline. Always return no_hit even if Pearl product title/image or ASR mentions sanitary pads, underwear, nipple covers, intimate care, gender-specific care, or private body-use products. If sexual exposure/sexual implication appears, evaluate category 1 instead. If the issue is illegal/prohibited goods or product mismatch, evaluate category 15 instead.
exemptions: All non-pornographic privacy-sensitive products are exempt in this workflow version because the category is disabled.
Normal shaver display in non-private context.
Sexual exposure/implication belongs to category 1, not category 19.
